name: Syrtaki
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Syrtaki in Wallgau

** Dance the night away to the rhythm of **Syrtaki** in the cozy mountain village of **Wallgau**! Whether you're a seasoned dancer or just love the lively atmosphere, this traditional Greek-inspired dance will have you moving to the beat. Enjoy a warm welcome in the heart of **Tirol**, where the alpine charm meets Mediterranean flair. After the dance, indulge in hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** or a glass of local **Apfelwein** to keep the good vibes going. Don’t miss out—**Syrtaki** in **Wallgau** is the perfect way to experience a night of fun, culture, and community! 🎉
